MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell would add door alerts to my Alexa setup and connect with my earlier interest in home security, provided it works at my door.",
    "The smart plug would let me control a compatible lamp through my existing Echo devices, adding a useful function to equipment I already have."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV sticks duplicate what my recently acquired 4K Max already does; sharing the same streaming features does not give me a reason to buy another.",
    "The older Echo Show and Dot models offer little after my newer purchases, and I have no current need for an additional display or speaker location.",
    "The internal SSD relates broadly to my computer purchases, but those purchases do not establish an upgrade need or compatibility with this drive."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My recent Alexa purchases seem to have been interpreted as a desire for more Alexa speakers and screens, regardless of whether they add a function I need.",
    "My history of buying computer accessories seems to have been stretched into interest in an internal hardware upgrade."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases already cover streaming, voice access, and a small smart display; buying the Show 5 stand further suggests I am equipping that device.",
    "An accessory that extends my existing setup can be more useful than another device with overlapping functions.",
    "Door installation and lamp compatibility matter to my interest in the doorbell and smart plug; compatibility also remains unresolved for the SSD."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my Alexa interest but often treated recently satisfied needs as reasons to buy duplicate devices."
}
